mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year inflation rate above 3.5% (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%) signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds rate is declining and year-over-year inflation exceeds 3.5%, the market anticipates a soft landing, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is below 4.0% and monthly job growth exceeds 100,000, the labor market strength supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS MoM growth > 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer confidence and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production exceeding 1.0% signals an imminent economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO MoM decline > 1.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDP growth above 2.0% QoQ), rising retail sales (RSAFS) signal strong consumer demand that supports corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 QoQ > 2.0% and RSAFS rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production is declining and the federal funds rate is rising, it signals a dual shock of economic weakness and monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO MoM decline > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS MoM rise > 0.1%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO MoM decline > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS MoM rise > 0.1%, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03.
